title: FIFA 20
rounds: Knockout Format – Depends on total number of registered teams. Each round eliminates the losing team until one champion remains.
rules:
• Format: 1v1 Knockout System
  • Platform: PlayStation 4 (PS4)
  • Controllers will be provided (keyboard use not allowed)
  • Players will have 45 seconds to select their team/players
  • Match Duration: 4 minutes total (2 halves)
  • Semi-Finals & Finals: Matches will be played in two halves with an extended duration. The exact match duration will be announced by the organizers.
judging:
• Matches are knockout format
  • Performance judged purely on in-game victory
